messages:
mike_marketing: Quick heads-up team: aiming to publish the 'Throughput vs Latency' benchmark blog tomorrow 9:00 AM PT. Need press coordination, CEO quote clearance, and final assets. Embargo until publish time. :eyes:
jess_pr: Got it. What embargo time should we list to press? Need a one-line pitch for the PR distro too.
mike_marketing: Embargo until 9:00 AM PT exactly. Pitch line: 'Redwood Inference releases benchmark demonstrating 2–5x cost reductions for production LLM inference across common workloads.'
ali_engineering: I've uploaded final graphs and raw CSVs to /shared/benchmarks/2025-05. High-res PNGs are available. Use `python tools/export_bench.py --input raw.csv --output figs/highres` for custom exports.
jess_pr: Can we get a 2-line methodology blurb for press? They'll ask about how the tests were run.
ali_engineering: 2-line blurb: 'We tested representative inference workloads across three model sizes and three GPU configurations. Metrics include p99 tail latency, throughput, and cost-per-token with and without prefix/KV caching.'
mike_marketing: @kevin_ceo please review the proposed quote and headline. Quote draft: "We built Redwood Inference to make production-grade LLMs predictable and affordable — this benchmark shows the economics of that work in production."
kevin_ceo: Small edit approved: change to "the economics of that work in production." Approve for quote.
sophia_support: Support will monitor channels for the first 4 hours post-publish. Please share the support playbook link so we can prep rotation and canned replies.
mike_marketing: Support playbook: https://drive.redwood/support/playbooks/benchmark-launch-2025.pdf. Adding an FAQ section to the blog for expected questions.
jess_pr: Timeline: 1) Assets in drive (done) 2) CEO quote (approved) 3) Embargo email to press list at 4:30 PM PT today 4) Blog scheduled in CMS for 9:00 AM PT 5) Social posts queued 6) Post-mortem call 1 PM PT tomorrow. Any blockers?
ali_engineering: CMS needs frontmatter flag `bench_publish=true`. Staging copy should have `noindex: true`. I validated on staging.
mike_marketing: @deploy-bot can you schedule the CMS publish job for 2025-05-24T16:00:00Z (9:00 AM PT) and enforce embargo?
deploy-bot: publish job created: job_id=bench-20250524-09, scheduled_time=1753460400, embargo=true. :white_check_mark:
mike_marketing: If any reporters push for early comment, send to PR and do not comment directly. We'll send embargo notes at 4:30 PM PT.
jess_pr: I'll send embargo email at 4:30 and ping top-tier contacts. I'll attach Q&A and offer interviews.
sophia_support: Rotation assigned. I'll post the Slack triage channel once email goes out.
mike_marketing: Thanks all — I'll post a final 'ready' message here at 4:15 PM PT.
kevin_ceo: Thanks team, excited to see this live. :tada:
